bugsFound.summary: Missing columns in Supabase daily_workouts: strategy_splits, coach_script
bugsFound.impact: When app.js syncs with Supabase, it attempts to load 'strategy_splits' and 'coach_script'. Because these columns do not exist in the database, in-memory structured strategy splits and AI coach scripts are overwritten with undefined. Furthermore, attempts by Vega Coach to save generated coach scripts fail with HTTP 400 (PGRST204).
bugsFound.remediation: Execute migration in Supabase SQL editor: ALTER TABLE daily_workouts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS strategy_splits JSONB; ALTER TABLE daily_workouts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS coach_script JSONB;

bugsFound.testTitle: Supabase Write Test for coach_script Column
bugsFound.impact: User cannot save generated Gemini AI coach scripts to the cloud database.
bugsFound.remediation: Execute: ALTER TABLE daily_workouts ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS coach_script JSONB;

bugsFound.testTitle: RLS Security Guard: training_weeks Table Immutability
bugsFound.summary: Unauthenticated anon role can alter training_weeks plan configuration
bugsFound.impact: Any visitor could alter week definitions, phase names, or planned distances in the shared database.
bugsFound.remediation: Enable RLS and restrict UPDATE on training_weeks to authenticated service role only.
